extraction_scope: Worker-6 adjudicated mechanism language from primary source; no direct membrane-disruption assay was performed in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper's source-reviewed mechanism evidence is structure-activity evidence: tryptophan and positively charged arginine were required for stronger MIC activity in this peptide set.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: synthetic R/W and X/R peptide series in this paper
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is SAR evidence from MIC comparisons, not a direct molecular target or membrane assay.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Background rationale is not promoted to direct_mechanism.
